patch.summary:
Choose Bright Data only if your buying job matches “Web data / proxy platform — pay-as-you-go from ~$4/GB residential; starter commitments fro” rather than Fly.io's shape. Choose Fly.io only if your buying job matches “Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regio” rather than Bright Data's shape. Workflow advantage: Bright Data leans web-data-collection; Fly.io leans cloud-paas. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Company-size focus: Bright Data (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Fly.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bright Data-leaning web-data-collection vs Fly.io-leaning cloud-paas.
